assertion.text: Erdős Problem #238: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $c_1,c_2>0$. Is it true that, for any sufficiently large $x$, there exist more than $c_1\log x$ many consecutive primes $\leq x$ such that the difference between any two is $>c_2$? Prize: no. Tags: number theory, primes.
